units.name: Skeleton
units.description: Restless bones marching from forgotten crypts.
units.lore: The grave gives back what it was lent. These bones answer the call long after the flesh forgot whose name they bore.

units.name: Ghoul
units.description: Feral clawed scavenger that outruns slow defenses.
units.lore: It fed on the fallen until hunger was all that remained. It runs because the hunger does; nothing else is left to tire.

units.name: Crypt Fiend
units.description: A spider-like horror wrapped in deathly chitin.
units.lore: Woven from spider and corpse in the deep vaults, it carries the cold of the crypt in every joint of its chitin.

units.name: Gargoyle
units.description: Winged stone predator that dives past the front line.
units.lore: Stone that remembers being carved to watch. Its wings are dead weight it has learned to lift out of spite.

units.name: Abomination
units.description: Patchworked brute that soaks damage instead of dodging it.
units.lore: Three corpses, one purpose. Every stitch is a vow the dead made to keep walking while the living still have gold to lose.

units.name: Necromancer
units.description: Dark acolyte worth killing early and worth gold when you do.
units.lore: He counts the dead the way the living count coin, and he is never short. Kill him before the ledger fills.

units.name: Banshee
units.description: Wailing spirit drifting between life and oblivion.
units.lore: Her wail is the last breath of a village that burned for the cause. She remembers every name, and she is not finished.

units.name: Frost Wyrm
units.description: Ancient dragon bound to ice and undeath.
units.lore: A dragon ten centuries dead, roused with ice where its heart was. The cold it breathes has forgotten what warmth was for.
